Burkina Faso.title: Burkina: 14 suspects arrested for robberies
Burkina Faso.summary: Fourteen people suspected of belonging to a network of robbers operating in Burkina Faso and in localities in neighboring countries have been arrested, the National Police said, claiming to have seized several firearms and ammunition. A group of 14 suspected robbers has been arrested, say the Burkinabe authorities . Composed mostly of people already convicted by the courts, it targeted shops, Orange Money shops, foundries and gold buyers, as well as gas stations, according to the police.
